sentences.text: FDA first posted the rifampin injection shortage on 2021-02-17 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21.
The shortage listing covers Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (NDC 63323-351-20), Mylan Institutional (NDC 67457-445-60), and Sanofi-Aventis U.S. LLC (NDC 0068-0597-01).
Our Corvale sites hold the Mylan-labeled 600 mg/10 mL vials (NDC 67457-445-60) manufactured by OneSource Specialty Pharma Limited in Bengaluru.
FDA inspected Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (FEI 1450022) on 2020-05-18 and classified it OAI, 275 days before the shortage posting.
A later Fresenius inspection on 2022-06-30 was also classified OAI, and a 2023-08-24 inspection was classified VAI.
The highest-ranked mitigation is to transfer 17 vials of 600 mg/10 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East, raising East from 4.4 to 10 days on hand while Lakeside retains 14 days.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
